k-001.q: What is the core difference between a team and a group?

wrong: A team always has more people than a group
A group has decision-making authority; a team only exchanges information
A team is evaluated individually; a group is evaluated collectively

wrong: Collective evaluation of the whole group
Evaluation based on the leader's results
Not evaluated

k-003.correct: Each member pursues their own goals
wrong: Stability over a period of time
Authority and the ability to make decisions
Operating within a social / organizational context

k-004.correct: The combined result is greater than the sum of each person's results
wrong: All members have identical skills
The whole group always agrees with one another
The degree to which the group is attractive to its members

k-005.correct: The degree to which the group is attractive to its members — they are satisfied and want to stay
wrong: The tendency to conform to group pressure and ignore opposing opinions

wrong: Group size
